estimate: 0.1 day of change; executor wall dominated by soak and package gates
scope: Two independently green milestones. Apply the single plan diff to host/daemon/decisionpacket_daemon_test.go only. daemon.go unchanged; mutations in scratch archives only. Executor report/raw logs under verification/world-iter334/. No git writes or mission-document edits.
environment: # Run from the executor's assigned repo root (pwd recorded in the report).
executor_constraints: No git writes of any kind: no add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/restore/apply/init/worktree; the controller commits. Read-only git archive/status/diff/show/rev-parse are allowed.

Apply only the plan single diff with patch -p1 after clean dry-run, full diff SHA256 and base-file checks. Final code touches only host/daemon/decisionpacket_daemon_test.go. daemon.go stays byte-identical to its base pin.

Run base and mutation drills only in git archive scratch copies. Temporary daemon.go edits for M1/M1b/M6/M7 must never enter the executor worktree. Restore both target files for every drill and check full before/edited/restored SHA256s.

Executor creates verification/world-iter334/executor-report.md and executor-*.txt. Tools, snapshots, temporary copies go under $WX outside the repo. Preserve existing verification evidence and both plan deliverables.
Do not edit design_docs/world-mission*.md; do not move plans/designs or touch main checkout, launchd files, or mission state. Controller handles queue/log/commit/PR/CI.
Every go test has -timeout; bound other long commands with alarm. Run package-scale gates sequentially; capture raw output and rc without a masking pipeline. Never finish by announcing a wait.
Copy exact commands from fenced blocks. Run shell loops/scripts with bash (interactive shell is zsh). No t.Parallel, no additional code or timing changes, no mutant gofmt.

A substitution that did not apply, missing test discovery, SKIP, build error, race detector finding, or Go timeout is an instrument/gate error, never a mutation kill. Require named killers and measured line numbers.

Any gate red at base is a finding to REPORT, not to work around. Do not fix unrelated issues, change binaries, relax timeouts, initialize git in copies, or claim acceptance green. Baseline read-only in an archive if needed; missing .git can itself fail host/pins and must be reported.

Socket-touching results from inside a sandbox are labelled UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX; a bind permission failure is neither pass nor fail for the sprint. Executor must obtain informative gates in its authorized environment or report them unverified.

Load, if used, consists solely of yes > /dev/null burners. Track and kill every burner you start before returning, including on red/interrupt; never kill unrelated processes. pgrep -x yes must have no PID output; pgrep -x yes | wc -l must print 0.
controller_only: mission documents and moves to implemented/
all 3 CI jobs green on final fix head, daemon ok in race gate
